episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Dodgers accidentally explodes the ship's energy core, sending the crew adrift.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Duck Dodgers must escort a beautiful secret agent to a Martian-controlled planet.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Duck Dodgers receives a robot crewmember, Roboto, but becomes jealous of the robot's perfect skills.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Duck Dodgers and Marvin compete in an interstellar race.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Duck Dodgers and Cadet are put on trial for destroying Earth's defensive shield.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Duck Dodgers responds to a planet's distress signal and mistakes its gelatinous inhabitants for the enemy invaders.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Duck Dodgers and Cadet come into contact with a flower that induces rapid aging.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Duck Dodgers and Cadet must retrieve a baby philosopher to save a peace conference.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: A fat-sucking space vampire hypnotizes Duck Dodgers into detaining Cadet for a pork dinner.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Drake Darkstar, an evil Duck Dodgers doppelganger, steals Dodgers' identity to escape incarceration.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: A rebel army of gophers vows to overtake Mars.

episodes_data.title: Duck Dodgers Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Duck Dodgers and Cadet investigate space barbarians planning to invade Earth.
